_comment: Mutable 'what this block uses from the PDK' sheet. It deliberately does NOT restate the pin: the release tag, commit, install subtree and install marker live once, in pdk-artifact.json (per-file sha256, checked by tools/verify_pdk.py before any simulator starts), which is the only copy any gate reads. Cold-start fetch commands, including the archive URL at the pinned commit: smoke-hbt/README.md. The pinned release is shared with the sibling canaries sg13g2-lna and sg13g2-sat-rx.
pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2 (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention)

devices_used_so_far.npn13G2: native ngspice VBIC (level=9) subckt in sg13g2_hbt_mod.lib, loaded through cornerHBT.lib sections; no OSDI. Used only by sim/smoke-hbt/.
